gap: TextOrder owns DM/SMS conversational close; Never86 owns shoppable buy-now + pain→sales. Do not pivot scripts to reservation/DM-chatbots — keep SKU purchase path.
summary: Strong social→order rival on messaging channels. Watch positioning vs Never86 buy-now; use as competitive contrast in owner outreach, not as a product fork.
